title: Version skew is reported, never resolved by dispatch
situation: 0040 asked whether a project's own pinned cratylus should win over the global one, with pnpm's globalShims as a candidate, so the agent's capabilities and the operator's command reach the same version. The operator, 2026-10-10: the cratylus command is the one thing that projects cratylus's artifacts onto a harness (0039), so the artifacts and the command they call disagree only when one was replaced without re-running install, which should be very rare. The established shape for that is a version-skew check, as a client and server report both versions and warn when they differ, rather than redirecting which build runs.
decision: The cratylus extension offers a version tool that reports the version of the projected artifacts, recorded by the cratylus that projected them, and the version of the cratylus command their capabilities reach. At every harness startup the extension compares the two and, when they differ, warns at once, naming both versions and the remedy: run install again with the cratylus in use. Nothing dispatches to a project's own pinned cratylus, and no shim chooses between builds.
consequences: Settles 0040 inside the delivery cut (0029): the cut builds the version tool and the startup check, and its examples include a mismatch warned at startup and a match that stays silent.
